title: Shiva Tandava Stotram
intro: A hymn to Shiva as the cosmic dancer, traditionally sung by Ravana: its last verse calls it दशवक्त्रगीतम्, 'sung by the ten-faced one'.
note: Verses 1 to 13 are the core of the stotra. Verses 14 and 15 appear in some editions and recitations only. Verses 16 and 17 are the phalashruti, the closing verses on the fruit of recitation.
author: Ravana
